title: Fix CI: strict TypeScript errors and flaky SystemPages test
body:
Console app build (`tsc`) fails on main due to ~215 implicit `any` parameters (TS7006), untyped generic calls (TS2347), and implicit `any` indexing (TS7053). One test (`SystemPages > RoleManagementPage`) fails intermittently due to a race condition.

### TypeScript strict mode violations (10 source files)

- **`view-config-schema.tsx`** — Added `: any` to all `render` and `visibleWhen` callback parameters (matching `ConfigField` interface signatures)
- **`view-config-schema.test.tsx`** — Typed `.find()`/`.filter()` callback parameters
- **`App.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx`, `DashboardView.tsx`, `AppSidebar.tsx`, `useObjectActions.ts`**, etc. — Added explicit types to event/callback parameters

### Untyped function calls in `ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx`

Cast `require('react')` inside `vi.mock()` factory to preserve generics:

```typescript
// Before — TS2347: Untyped function calls may not accept type arguments
const React = require('react');
const pastRef = React.useRef<any[]>([]); // ❌

// After
const React = require('react') as typeof import('react');
const pastRef = React.useRef<any[]>([]); // ✅
```

Also typed `collapsed` state as `Record<string, boolean>` to fix TS7053 indexing error.

### Flaky `SystemPages.test.tsx`

Assertions on async-rendered content were outside `waitFor`, causing race conditions in CI:

```typescript
// Before — passes locally, fails in CI
await waitFor(() => { expect(mockFind).toHaveBeenCalledWith('sys_role'); });
expect(screen.getByText('Admin')).toBeInTheDocument(); // ❌ data not rendered yet

// After
await waitFor(() => { expect(mockFind).toHaveBeenCalledWith('sys_role'); });
await waitFor(() => { expect(screen.getByText('Admin')).toBeInTheDocument(); }); // ✅
```

Applied to all 5 similar assertions across User/Org/Role/AuditLog/Permission tests.

All 366 test files pass (6,723 tests).
